# baffinbay_known_service (Data Source)

Retrieves a Baffin Bay-managed Known Service by UUID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "baffinbay_known_service" "github_pages" {
  name = "gh-pages"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The Known Service UUID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be configured.
- `name` (String) The exact, case-sensitive Known Service name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be configured.

### Read-Only

- `tags` (List of String)
- `upstream_provider` (String) The upstream provider or owner of the service.
